list: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden, 27 visible
list_note: Names, descriptions and grades are as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles-linked guides, which agree on every entry. Hidden flags follow the reported 28-hidden split (27 bronze + 1 gold): story trophies and the cryptic one-line trophies are hidden until earned. Verify each flag in-game at launch. The game launches 19 November 2026; where no verified method exists yet, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies (PS5)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide (missable + difficulty, by name)
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
OutputLag — GTA 6 Trophy List (hidden split, missable detail)
Rockstar Games — GTA VI Trailer 2 (Leonida setting, by name)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Follow this guide's roadmap in order (story first, then side characters, collectibles, activities and money) and it will be the last trophy you earn. Source: Exophase trophy list (platinum = earn every other trophy).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first story mission, so this is unmissable: just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission-complete screen. Source: Exophase trophy list (complete Gone Fishing).

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Unmissable — it comes from playing the story. Before leaving Chapter 1, do the Chapter 1 meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude (see that trophy), the one missable in the game. Source: Exophase trophy list; missable warning: PowerPyx / GTABase via OutputLag.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Unmissable. This is also the chapter where both protagonists become playable, which opens most side content — a good point to start stranger missions and activities between story beats. Source: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Unmissable. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter — guides recommend one per chapter because there is reportedly no mission replay, so a chapter-start save is your safety net for anything chapter-bound. Source: Exophase trophy list; save advice: OutputLag trophy list.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Unmissable. By now most side systems are open, so use the gaps between story missions to chip away at collectibles (cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles) rather than leaving them all for after the story. Source: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the final story mission to its end — the only hidden gold trophy. Unmissable as long as you finish the story. Make a manual save before starting it: it is the natural point of no return, and a save here lets you mop up anything left without replaying the finale. Source: Exophase trophy list; save advice: OutputLag trophy list.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks through normal story progress, so it cannot be missed — keep playing the story and it pops at the mission-complete screen. Source: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It unlocks through normal story progress and cannot be missed. Heist missions in GTA usually have a setup phase first — finish any setup the game asks for, then the heist itself. Source: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks through normal story progress and cannot be missed — just follow the mission objectives to the end. Source: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks through normal story progress and cannot be missed. Source: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown (VCIA is Vice City International Airport). It unlocks through normal story progress and cannot be missed. Source: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks through normal story progress and cannot be missed — follow the mission objectives through to the complete screen. Source: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's in-game completion checklist — the hardest trophy in the set, rated about 200 hours for the platinum overall. The checklist is the usual GTA mix: story missions, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and exploration. Do not leave it to the end blind: tick off the counted trophies in this guide as you go (stunts, races, challenges, cards, WAiNK, vehicles, areas) and the 100% will be nearly done when the story ends. Source: Exophase trophy list; time/difficulty: KeenGamer platinum roadmap.
trophies.source: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, airtime and similar driving feats, tracked by the game's stunt counter. This is a grind, not a skill gate: it accumulates across the whole playthrough, so drive fast and jump often from the start instead of saving it for the end. Check the counter in the stats menu to see your progress. Source: Exophase trophy list (250 stunts).

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, racing, shooting range, arcade, bowling, meditation, drone racing and the other open-world activities are the pool to draw from. You only need to try each type, not win or master it, so sample everything as it unlocks and this pops early. Source: Exophase trophy list (each activity type once; 9 types per the starter list).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Find a shooting range, work through its challenge list, and replay any challenge until you hit the gold score — there is no limit on retries. Do a few each visit rather than all 42 in one sitting, and use the weapon each challenge is built for. Source: Exophase trophy list (gold in all challenges; 42 challenges per the starter list).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is a separate race, so you need a win at every one, not 14 wins at the same spot. Learn each course's corners on a practice run, then race to win; the counter is per location. Source: Exophase trophy list (win at every location; 14 locations per the starter list).

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not 20 wins of the same one. Work through the race list across Leonida (street, off-road and water races all count toward the set) and tick each new win off. Pick the fastest vehicle you own for each race type. Source: Exophase trophy list (win 20 different races).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: out-fish Cal within the challenge's rules (bigger catch or more fish, as the challenge states). If you lose, retry — fishing challenges can be attempted again. It helps to have tried regular fishing first so you know the minigame. Source: Exophase trophy list (beat Cal in a fishing challenge).

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at an arcade cabinet, any title. You do not need a high score or a win, just a completed game. Walk into an arcade, pick a cabinet and play it through. Source: Exophase trophy list (complete an arcade game).

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Side-character strands unlock as you meet each character in the open world — take Andy's missions whenever they appear on the map and the strand ends with this trophy. Not missable: stranger and side missions stay available in free roam after the story. Source: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Take Kenton's missions as they appear and follow the strand to its end. Not missable — side strands stay open in free roam. Source: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Take Billy's missions as they appear and follow the strand to its end. Not missable — side strands stay open in free roam. Source: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons on the map as you explore — start one, follow its strand to the end, and repeat until 8 strands are done. The named side characters (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of the strands, so you need three more beyond them. Not missable: strands stay available after the story. Source: Exophase trophy list (8 strands).

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Take Randy's missions as they appear and follow the strand to its end. Not missable — side strands stay open in free roam. Source: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Take Tyrone's missions as they appear and follow the strand to its end. Not missable — side strands stay open in free roam. Source: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — and this is the ONE trophy flagged as possibly missable. The first spot is at Lucia's balcony in Chapter 1 and it disappears after that chapter, and there is reportedly no mission replay, so meditate at every spot the moment you find it and never walk past one. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter as a safety net. If a spot will not trigger, try approaching it as the character the spot belongs to. Source: Exophase trophy list (18 spots); missable warning: PowerPyx and GTABase, reported by OutputLag.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunt is a side strand: talk to Bret, follow his directions to the animal's territory, and take it down with a clean shot — hunting trophies in GTA usually want the animal killed, not just found. If the animal does not appear, check the time of day and weather the hunt hints at. Source: Exophase trophy list (hunt a unique animal for Bret).

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, interiors and out in the world — and sets only count when every card in the set is found. Collect cards as you explore rather than hunting them all at the end, and use the in-game collection screen to see which sets are one or two cards short. Source: Exophase trophy list (3 sets).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK It is a photo/tag-style interaction at marked spots — visit a spot, use the action, and move on. This is a long exploration grind, so do it alongside the 52-area exploration (The Goodtime State) and the 100-vehicle discovery (Whip It Good): the three overlap naturally as you cover the map. Source: Exophase trophy list (100 locations).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list — the assorted feats the game tracks (driving, combat, exploration and activity challenges). Pick the easiest ones first from the challenges menu and let the rest accumulate naturally; 50 is a large share of the list, so expect this late in the playthrough. Source: Exophase trophy list (50 challenges).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. The partner requirement is the trick: do it during a mission or free-roam stretch where your partner is with you, raise heat to 4 stars, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. Fast cars and the countryside help more than hiding in the city. Source: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time — the run fails if the wanted level drops to zero between robberies. Plan a route of three close shops, rob each quickly, and keep moving between them so the heat stays on. Do it with your partner present; solo robberies do not count. Source: Exophase trophy list (3 shops back-to-back, wanted level kept).

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or enter each one and it counts toward the total. This accumulates naturally across a full playthrough if you vary what you drive, but to finish it, sweep the map's distinct districts and vehicle types (cars, bikes, boats, trucks) rather than driving the same car all game. The in-game vehicle list shows what you have found. Source: Exophase trophy list (100 vehicles).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus (the slow-mo aiming mode). Pick a fight with a group of at least 5 enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all 5 before it ends — do not let the meter run out with enemies still standing. Gang hideouts and police chases give you the crowd you need. Source: Exophase trophy list (5 enemies, one Combat Focus).

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — in plain words, steal a plane and take off without following the airport's rules. Get airside, take a plane, and get airborne; expect a wanted level on the way out. No verified step-by-step method exists yet beyond the description, so treat the runway takeoff as the goal and improvise the approach. Source: Exophase trophy list.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is the only confirmed hint — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' points at the Rhino tank. The sensible reading: get into a Rhino tank and cause havoc with it (drive it, fire it, survive the wanted level it brings). No verified method exists yet, so do not trust a specific step-by-step claim until players confirm one; getting a Rhino and using it in combat is the honest starting point. Source: Exophase trophy list (description only).

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery, not a smash-and-grab. Case the store, go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, leave and retry: detection fails the attempt. Source: Exophase trophy list (undetected jewelry robbery).

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vault robberies are the bigger heist-style robberies — plan each one (approach, entry, escape route) and do not linger after the vault is open, since the escape is part of the trophy. Five separate successful vault robberies are needed. Source: Exophase trophy list (5 bank vaults).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — stop one (ram it or block the road), crack it open, take the cash and get away before the police box you in. A fast getaway car parked nearby makes the escape part far easier. Source: Exophase trophy list (rob an armored truck and escape).

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — Vice City, the Keys, the Everglades and every named district in between. An area counts when you enter it; the map fills in as you go, so sweep the edges of the map systematically and check which areas are still unvisited. Pair this with WAiNK It (100 locations) and vehicle discovery (100 vehicles) since all three reward covering the map. Source: Exophase trophy list (explore all of Leonida; 52 areas per the starter list).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Gangs run their own illicit spots around Leonida — find one operation per gang, hit it and get out. Keep a note of which gangs you have done, since the trophy needs all 9 and it is easy to rob the same gang's spots twice. Source: Exophase trophy list (one operation per gang; 9 gangs per the starter list).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view — the description is the whole method. Find a bar or beachfront spot on Ocean Beach with a view, buy the cocktail there, and the trophy should pop. No verified step-by-step method exists yet beyond the description, so do not trust a claim that names a specific bar until players confirm it. Source: Exophase trophy list (description only).

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through a showroom's glass front. Pick a showroom, get a car inside or aimed at it, and floor it through the window. The 'classic style' wording points at the old GTA showroom-smash gag, so the exit through the glass is the point. No verified method exists yet beyond the description. Source: Exophase trophy list (description only).

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — 'follow-through' suggests completing a full game or a full follow-through on a bowl. Play a game at that specific alley (not just any bowling lane) and finish it. No verified step-by-step method exists yet beyond the description. Source: Exophase trophy list (description only).

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The description is the only confirmed hint — 'a partnership with mass appeal' suggests doing something as a duo (Jason and Lucia together) that draws a crowd or goes public. No verified method exists yet, and any specific claim about what triggers it is unconfirmed: play the partner activities and public-facing side content as they come, and this is likely to pop on its own. Do not trust an unverified how-to. Source: Exophase trophy list (description only).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make story choices as you play — the description ('choices made, for better or worse') points at the game's decision moments, and some trackers list a count tied to them. The exact number of choices needed is unconfirmed, so the honest advice is: do not skip decision prompts, make a choice every time one appears, and keep playing — it should pop through normal story play. Source: Exophase trophy list (description only).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description is the only confirmed hint — 'second time's the charm' suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt after failing it once. No verified method exists yet: the sensible approach is to retry things you fail (races, challenges, activities) rather than avoiding failure, and this may pop on a natural retry. Do not trust a specific trigger claim until players confirm one. Source: Exophase trophy list (description only).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description is the only confirmed hint — 'what the hell just happened?' points at a strange, unexpected encounter somewhere in Leonida (the classic GTA easter-egg style event). No verified location or trigger exists yet: explore odd places, investigate strange sights, and this should pop when you stumble into the right event. Any guide naming an exact spot before launch is guessing. Source: Exophase trophy list (description only).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock people over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon (a bat, for example) and bowl pedestrians over. The name is a bowling pun: you need the drive-by melee hit to connect, so drive slowly past a group and swing. Expect a wanted level; do it somewhere you can escape easily. The exact count needed is unconfirmed beyond the description. Source: Exophase trophy list (description only).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — they are dirty money you cannot spend directly, so take them to your laundering contacts and convert them over time. The total is cumulative across the whole game, so bank every bill you get instead of ignoring them; by late game the total should be close. Source: Exophase trophy list ($250,000 laundering).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything the shops sell. The total is cumulative, so it builds naturally if you buy gear as you go; if you are short late in the game, buy expensive items (weapons and outfits) to top it up. Do not hoard cash for no reason — spending counts here. Source: Exophase trophy list ($100,000 spent).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are bought from the in-game property market — check the property listings as new areas open, and buy each garage when you can afford it. They also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you are discovering for Whip It Good, so buy them as you explore. Source: Exophase trophy list (all garage properties; 8 per the starter list).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the in-game delivery/vehicle app. Open the app on the in-game phone, register a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until 10 are registered. It pairs naturally with discovering 100 vehicles (Whip It Good): register each interesting vehicle as you find it. Source: Exophase trophy list (10 vehicles).
